metadata.description: Legion Core — the model-agnostic orchestration engine under the hood of an AI agent: models, harnesses, loops, self-improving agents. The stack, not another wrapper. Ships scoped delegation, multi-model fan-out, telemetry/cost reporting, doctor/self-learn/heal loops, and cross-harness setup for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, opencode, Hermes, and Pi. One orchestrator, a legion of models.

plugins.name: legion-router
plugins.description: Legion's multi-model brain: registry-driven routing and scoped delegation across Claude, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Hermes, and Pi. Implemented adapters return a verified, metered diff from an isolated worktree. Ships `legion-delegate`, executor wrappers, generic GitHub issue intake via `legion-intake` (delegate, cursor, or a compatible custom worker), the loopback :8082 metering proxy, shared cost table, and codex-json parser.

plugins.name: legion-observability
plugins.description: See everything Legion does and close the self-learning loop. Unified legion.span.v1 telemetry, legion-report cost/success/latency, legion-bench deterministic repeated gates, legion-self-learn evidence/proposals, review-only legion-improve draft PRs, legion-trace, legion-otel-export, and legion-doctor verification.

plugins.name: legion-orchestrate
plugins.description: Legion's dynamic multi-model orchestrator: the active primary decomposes work, configured executor roles fan out scoped slices, independent roles cross-verify, and the primary synthesizes and gates. Ships `legion-fanout` plus the LEGION_ULTRACODE max-exhaustive workflow.

plugins.name: legion-run
plugins.description: First-class Legion heavy-task runner skill. Invokes `legion-run` direct mode or domain-plugin mode to execute sizeable coding work through doctor, prior hints, planning, route/fan-out/apply, final review, validation/evaluation, HTML evidence, share accounting, validation-led self-learning, and heal planning.

plugins.name: legion-setup
plugins.description: Install and update Legion, wire Codex/Cursor/opencode bridges, verify Pi readiness, manage Hermes's native skill-discovery link, and make Legion the repository-default workflow without replacing existing instructions. Ships `legion-setup`, `legion-init`, and native harness setup commands; daily refresh/self-learning is opt-in.

plugins.name: legion-codex-mode
plugins.description: The Codex-CLI-primary routing brain for Legion — the mirror of legion-router. When you run Legion under Codex, the codex_workhorse ref does most of the work; this skill tells you when to hand a task up to the configured Claude role via `legion-claude` (deep architecture, polished/complex frontend with the impeccable skill, final cross-model review, tie-breaks, when stuck) versus inline — with automatic configured-Codex fallback if the Claude limit is hit. Also maps what runs natively on Codex (MCPs, mirrored skills, bridged commands/agents) so you don't reach for Claude needlessly. Triggers on running Legion under Codex, deep-design/frontend-polish/final-review smells, or 'ask claude' / 'second opinion from claude'.

plugins.name: legion-opencode-mode
plugins.description: The decision guide for an opencode-primary Legion session — the opencode counterpart of legion-codex-mode. When you drive Legion under opencode you do most of the work yourself; this skill tells you WHICH kind of task is worth handing to another model and to WHOM — Claude for deep architecture and polished frontend (with the impeccable skill), a workhorse model for bulk implementation, a different model for a second opinion — versus keeping it inline. Triggers on running Legion under opencode, on deep-design / frontend-polish / final-review judgement calls, or on 'ask claude' / 'get a second opinion' while working in opencode.

plugins.name: legion-hermes-mode
plugins.description: The routing guide for a Hermes-primary Legion session. Hermes can work inline as a registered coding family and use a metered, isolated `legion-delegate run --executor <different-harness>` handoff for independent implementation, review, and tie-breaks. Triggers when Hermes or one of its cron jobs / skills needs to build, fix, test, review, or delegate code work.

plugins.name: legion-pi-mode
plugins.description: The Pi-primary Legion routing guide for when Pi is driving a coding task: decide what stays inline and when to ask another harness for a second opinion, implementation, or review through a metered, isolated Legion handoff.

plugins.name: legion-code-intel
plugins.description: Optional Legion code-intelligence diagnostics. Runs repo-native TypeScript and Pyright checks, filters changed-file diagnostics, emits legion.code-intel.v1 artifacts, and can append legion.span.v1 telemetry for benchmarkable pre-PR gates without making LSP servers a core dependency.
